charts.title: TOI-1259 A b: orbits around TOI-1259 A
charts.description: The orbits of TOI-1259 A's planets in this map from above, to scale, with TOI-1259 A b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Veldhuis et al. 2026 (2026A&A...708A.272V), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname VELDHUIS_ET_AL_2026): P 3.4779792 d

charts.title: TOI-1259 A b: its transit
charts.description: TOI-1259 A b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (81, 85, 86) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 288735205, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 10-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Folded on the app's orbit; 10-min bins.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
